title: Adobe After Effects Advanced Core v2

domain.name: Adobe After Effects Advanced
domain.description: Advanced After Effects production covering expressions, compositing, keying, tracking, 3D integration, procedural motion systems, templates, color pipeline, performance, and Premiere integration. Version-specific UI behavior belongs in Current Intelligence.

competencies.name: Expression-Driven Motion Systems
competencies.description: Use expressions, controls, reusable rigs, and procedural relationships to build maintainable motion systems.
competencies.purpose: Replace fragile manual keyframe duplication with controllable systems.

units.title: Expressions encode relationships, not decoration
units.content: Useful expression systems expose intent through controls and simple dependencies instead of hiding logic across many layers.

units.title: Expression rig workflow
units.content: Define behavior, centralize controls, use predictable property references, guard edge cases, test duplicate/precomp behavior, and document assumptions before exposing the rig to editors.

units.title: Expression failure modes
units.content: Avoid circular references, layer-name dependencies with no safeguards, giant unreadable expressions, and using expressions where a simple keyframe or parent is clearer.

drills.title: Build a reusable graphic animation rig
drills.prompt: Design an expression-driven lower-third system with timing, color, text, and responsive layout controls.

competencies.name: Advanced Compositing, Keying & Rotoscoping
competencies.description: Combine keys, masks, mattes, despill, edge treatment, grain, and light integration into believable composites.
competencies.purpose: Create convincing composites with controlled technical stages.

units.title: A good composite aligns multiple cues
units.content: Edges, color, contrast, grain, depth, motion blur, light direction, lens character, and contact relationships all contribute to integration.

units.title: Composite workflow
units.content: Prepare source, isolate foreground, refine matte, handle spill and edges, match exposure/color, rebuild grain and blur, add environmental interaction, then inspect at 100 percent and in motion.

units.title: Composite failure modes
units.content: Avoid crushing matte edges, using one keyer pass for every problem, over-denoising source, forgetting motion blur/grain, and judging only on a small viewer.

drills.title: Finish a difficult green-screen composite
drills.prompt: Plan keying and integration for uneven green screen, hair detail, spill, and moving camera footage.

competencies.name: Tracking, Stabilization & Matchmove
competencies.description: Use point, planar, camera, and object tracking plus stabilization with correct coordinate and lens assumptions.
competencies.purpose: Attach graphics and effects convincingly to moving footage.

units.title: Track quality depends on what motion model fits the shot
units.content: Translation, perspective, planar change, parallax, camera motion, rolling shutter, and lens distortion require different tracking strategies.

units.title: Tracking workflow
units.content: Assess motion and lens, choose the appropriate tracker, use stable high-contrast features, exclude occlusions, solve, inspect error visually, correct drift, and test overlays at frame extremes.

units.title: Tracking failure modes
units.content: Avoid forcing a point track onto perspective change, tracking motion-blurred or changing features blindly, stabilizing before deciding the desired camera behavior, and accepting low error numbers without visual validation.

drills.title: Plan a difficult screen replacement
drills.prompt: Track and replace a reflective handheld screen with perspective change and partial occlusion.

competencies.name: 3D Camera, Lighting & Layer Integration
competencies.description: Coordinate 3D layers, cameras, lights, depth, imported elements, and compositing in hybrid 2D/3D scenes.
competencies.purpose: Create dimensional motion graphics without losing scene coherence.

units.title: 2.5D scenes still obey spatial relationships
units.content: Camera perspective, parallax, layer depth, light falloff, scale, and depth-of-field cues must support the intended space.

units.title: Hybrid-scene workflow
units.content: Define camera and world scale, separate foreground/mid/background depth, place lights intentionally, use precomps with collapse/3D behavior deliberately, and preview camera extremes before polish.

units.title: 3D integration failures
units.content: Avoid arbitrary Z spacing, mixing incompatible scale assumptions, accidental camera clipping, lights affecting unintended layers, and fake depth that breaks when the camera moves.

drills.title: Build a dimensional title sequence
drills.prompt: Design a 3D-layer title scene with camera move, lighting, atmosphere, and foreground occlusion.

competencies.name: Procedural Motion & Template Systems
competencies.description: Build reusable animation systems with Essential Properties, controls, protected design rules, and responsive layout behavior.
competencies.purpose: Scale branded motion across many edits and formats.

units.title: Templates should expose intent, not implementation
units.content: Editors need a small set of safe controls while timing logic, typography, spacing, and brand constraints remain protected.

units.title: Template-system workflow
units.content: Define editable content, build responsive layout rules, centralize style controls, test extreme text lengths and durations, expose only stable properties, and validate use from Premiere when required.

units.title: Template failures
units.content: Avoid exposing internal layer properties randomly, hard-coded widths, animations tied to one exact phrase, and templates requiring missing plugins or fonts with no fallback.

drills.title: Design a production MOGRT family
drills.prompt: Plan a lower-third, quote card, and stat graphic family with shared brand controls and responsive behavior.

competencies.name: Performance, Cache & Render Optimization
competencies.description: Diagnose expression cost, effects, precomps, resolution, cache, GPU/CPU bottlenecks, and render failures.
competencies.purpose: Keep complex compositions responsive and predictable at render time.

units.title: Preview speed and render speed can have different bottlenecks
units.content: Cache state, effects, expressions, decoding, layer count, resolution, GPU acceleration, and output codec affect different stages.

units.title: Performance investigation loop
units.content: Measure a representative frame or range, isolate heavy layers/effects, disable branches methodically, inspect expression and precomp cost, test resolution/proxy choices, and compare renders before permanent changes.

units.title: Performance failure modes
units.content: Avoid purging cache as the only diagnosis, pre-rendering everything before finding the cause, lowering comp resolution globally, and replacing editable systems with baked media too early.

drills.title: Profile a slow After Effects composition
drills.prompt: Create a measurement plan for a heavy motion-graphics comp with 3D layers, blur, particles, and expressions.

competencies.name: Color Pipeline & Linear Compositing
competencies.description: Understand working spaces, linear-light operations, source interpretation, display transforms, and export behavior in compositing.
competencies.purpose: Preserve predictable color and physically sensible blends.

units.title: Compositing math depends on color representation
units.content: Blurs, glows, blending, exposure, and light integration can behave differently depending on whether values are treated in display-referred or scene-linear space.

units.title: Color-pipeline workflow
units.content: Identify source color spaces, choose working intent, interpret footage correctly, separate technical transforms from creative grading, validate scopes and reference images, and test actual exported files in the delivery path.

units.title: Color-pipeline failures
units.content: Avoid double transforms, guessing source gamma, mixing unmanaged assets, using LUTs as unknown black boxes, and assuming preview appearance guarantees export interpretation.

drills.title: Plan a linear-light composite
drills.prompt: Define a color pipeline for CG elements, camera footage, glow, and final delivery.

competencies.name: After Effects / Premiere Production Integration
competencies.description: Manage Dynamic Link, renders, MOGRTs, versioning, source changes, and fallback handoff between applications.
competencies.purpose: Preserve editability without letting cross-app dependencies destabilize delivery.

units.title: Integration trades convenience for dependency depth
units.content: Live links are useful early, while stable intermediates can reduce risk near delivery or handoff.

units.title: Cross-app workflow
units.content: Define naming and version rules, keep source comps organized, expose reusable controls through templates, decide when live links should become rendered intermediates, and verify fonts/plugins/color behavior on the receiving system.

units.title: Integration failure modes
units.content: Avoid unversioned linked comps, deep dependency chains near deadline, missing plugin/font assumptions, and replacing final graphics without checking editorial timing.

drills.title: Design a resilient motion-graphics handoff
drills.prompt: Plan how a Premiere editor and After Effects artist should exchange custom shots and reusable graphics over multiple revisions.
